tagline: End Big Tech's assault on free speech by opening up the Internet and giving people their voices back
hero_kpi_rationale: The company holds a massive amount of cash and digital assets (including bitcoin), which represents a unique strategic position in the tech sector, serving both as a store of value and as financial leverage in a context of uncertain monetization.

kpis.name: Cash and digital assets
kpis.explanation: Total cash, short-term investments and digital assets held by the company.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, TMTG held approximately $2,473.2 million in cash, cash equivalents, short-term investments, equity securities, receivables and digital assets.
kpis.signal: Massive cash position for a company of modest size, supported by an engaged investor base.

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of company debt, excluding lease liabilities.
kpis.description: TMTG had approximately $947.1 million in debt as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant debt level but covered by very high cash reserves.

kpis.name: Restricted cash
kpis.explanation: Locked-in cash serving as collateral for debt or other obligations.
kpis.description: The $31.3 million in restricted cash serves as collateral for debt and can be used to purchase bitcoin or associated securities.
kpis.signal: Used as collateral for debt and for bitcoin purchases.

kpis.name: Truth+ launch
kpis.explanation: Gradual rollout of the streaming platform in three phases.
kpis.description: Truth+ was launched in three phases in 2024-2025: Phase 1 integration into Truth Social (August 7, 2024), Phase 2 standalone release (October 21, 2024), Phase 3 availability on connected TVs (October 23, 2024). Global launch on July 7, 2025.
kpis.signal: Strategic launch of a streaming service to diversify the ecosystem.

kpis.name: Truth.Fi launch
kpis.explanation: Start of the FinTech initiative with bitcoin strategy and America First investment vehicles.
kpis.description: Announced on January 29, 2025, Truth.Fi marks TMTG's entry into financial services. SMAs launched on April 15, 2025, ETF agreement on April 22, 2025, five ETFs launched on December 30, 2025 (TSSD, TSFN, TSIC, TSES, TSRS) aligned with its America First mission.
kpis.signal: Ecosystem expansion into financial services, with bitcoin treasury.

risks.title: Limited operating history
risks.score_rationale: TMTG has limited operating history, which makes it difficult to evaluate its business model and prospects. This increases risks associated with investment.

risks.title: Intense competition in social media and streaming
risks.score_rationale: Competition is a major risk for TMTG as it operates in a crowded and competitive market dominated by established tech giants.

risks.title: Dependence on Donald Trump's reputation
risks.score_rationale: TMTG's success depends significantly on the popularity of its brand associated with Donald Trump and its ability to retain the support of its user base.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and hacking risks
risks.score_rationale: TMTG is exposed to significant cybersecurity risks, including malware attacks, data breaches and threats from hackers.

risks.title: Complex and evolving regulatory environment
risks.score_rationale: TMTG is subject to complex and evolving regulations regarding data protection, privacy, content and potentially financial services.

risks.title: Stock price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The market for TMTG's stock is characterized by significant volatility, which can result in substantial losses for investors.

risks.title: Litigation and civil liability risks
risks.score_rationale: TMTG is exposed to litigation risks, particularly due to liability for content published on Truth Social and content moderation issues.

risks.title: Reputation and brand image risks
risks.score_rationale: TMTG's reputation is critical to its success, and any event damaging its reputation could have a major negative impact on adoption and business prospects.

ai_positioning.summary: Trump Media Technology Group Corp. uses AI for content moderation on Truth Social in partnership with vendor HIVE, implementing a moderation system described as robust, fair, and viewpoint-neutral. AI plays a limited operational role in content moderation without constituting a central technology strategy.
evidence: Using human moderators and an artificial intelligence vendor known as HIVE, Truth Social has developed what TMTG believes is a robust, fair, and viewpoint-neutral moderation system
